title: Bee Removal Hempstead | Professional Service
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket removal in Hempstead, Long Island. Nest treatment and removal from homes and businesses. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: An active wasp, hornet, or yellow jacket nest in your Hempstead home is a structural problem that demands immediate professional attention. The Best Pest Control NYC treats and removes nests from wall voids, attics, soffits, and eaves throughout Hempstead — from the historic Village Green area to the residential neighborhoods near Eisenhower Park. Our licensed technicians identify the species, locate the nest entrance, treat the colony, remove accessible nest material, and seal every entry point to prevent recolonization. We also treat carpenter bee galleries and ground-nesting bees.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Hempstead residents for years with fast, reliable bee removal that prioritizes safety and eco-friendly practices. Our local expertise means we understand the specific challenges facing Hempstead homeowners, from colonial-style houses to modern apartment complexes, and we offer competitive pricing of $350-$550 with same-day service available.
localContext: Hempstead's mix of historic homes, dense residential areas, and proximity to parks like Eisenhower Park creates ideal conditions for wasp and hornet colonies seeking shelter in attics, wall voids, soffits, and landscaping. Yellow jackets nest in ground burrows and wall cavities throughout the village and Town of Hempstead. Our team is familiar with the architectural styles throughout Hempstead, ensuring safe nest treatment and removal without damaging your property's structure or character.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Hempstead?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Hempstead home?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency service throughout Hempstead and Long Island. Most nest treatments are completed within 2–4 hours, though nests in difficult-to-access wall voids or attics may require additional time. We prioritize urgent situations involving allergies or high-traffic areas.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Hempstead?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Do you remove all types of wasps, hornets, and bees in Hempstead?
faqs.answer: Yes, we treat wasp and hornet nests — including yellow jackets, bald-faced hornets, paper wasps, and mud daubers — as well as carpenter bee galleries and ground-nesting bees throughout Long Island. Each species requires different treatment techniques, and our licensed technicians have the expertise to safely eliminate any stinging insect nest in your Hempstead property.
